category: currency exchange rate API (168 currencies and metals)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 100 API requests a month, daily updates, historical rates, HTTPS.
free_tier.notes: One request is any call with a valid key; time-frame and change queries and many currencies in one call count as one. The next plan up, Basic, is USD 14.99 a month for 10,000 requests. The pricing FAQ says quotes refresh every 60 minutes on Free and Basic, the general FAQ says every day on Free; the plan card says daily updates.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 100 requests a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET /live and /historical with an access_key; /timeframe, /convert and /change are other endpoints, and their plan gate was not read
chaining: 100 requests a month is a test allowance; a daily rate pull uses about 30, so little is left for history.

limits.value: 100 requests a month on the Free plan

limits_note: Rate per minute: not stated on the pages read. The timeframe endpoint spans up to 365 days; whether the Free plan includes it was not readable, because the plan table lost its check and cross marks. Bulk path: none on the free plan.
binding_note: 100 requests a month is spent in days of testing, and no per-minute rate is published.

identity_cost.detail: The free sign-up form asks for first name, last name, email, password, address, postal code, country and city (state in some countries), with a Turnstile check. The card block of the form is marked paid-only and hidden.

reliability_note: At 100 percent of the allowance the FAQ says overage fees apply, and the plan table lists an Overage line; what the Free plan does past 100 requests was not read.
confidence_note: Quota, refresh and licence fields are read from the home page and FAQ; the sign-up fields are read from the form markup of the free sign-up page. The documentation pages did not read in full. No key was created.
